01 / The idea

Henri’s brings the friends.
Le Gilda sets the scene.

Henri’s is gathering a small selection of brands for a three-day pop-up in central Luxembourg. Le Gilda Club is bringing the space to life with food, a bar, music and places to sit, catch up and enjoy the weekend.

A shared setting where visitors can meet the people behind the products — and where each brand has room to tell its own story.

Meet Henri’s.

A clothing brand with its own character and a circle of friends. Henri’s anchors the pop-up, joined by independent brands with a distinct point of view.

Explore Henri’s

Welcome to Le Gilda Club.

The host behind the setting, the atmosphere and the gathering. Le Gilda Club brings its event experience to a weekend built around discovery and spending time together.

02 / The weekend

Come for a browse.
Stay for the company.

A pop-up woven into a full weekend of food, drinks and music.

Discover the brands up close.

Explore the brands, meet their founders, have something to eat and take a seat. The bar will be open throughout the weekend.

A little later, a little louder.

On Saturday evening, the space shifts into a Le Gilda Club DJ session, with the brand displays put away beforehand.

Friday / 23 October

The first hello.

Opening day. Discover the brands and settle into the weekend over a drink.

Saturday / 24 October

Day into evening.

Pop-up, food and music, followed by an evening DJ session planned from around 21:00.

Sunday / 25 October

One more look.

A final day to revisit your favourites, meet the brands and enjoy the space.

Opening hours, retail closing time and the final music programme are being confirmed.

03 / The setting

A little room
for everything.

A central Luxembourg venue with a glazed indoor area, a covered outdoor space and an open terrace. Each area plays a part, from browsing the collections to taking a break with friends.

A first look at the layout

Find your place.

Working proposal: Henri’s and five guest brands, with shared social spaces.

H = Henri’s · 1–5 = guest brands
Six brands, one shared setting.

Henri’s in the covered outdoor area; three brands in the glazed interior and two outside. The raised terrace is reserved for seating.

Access: entrance → open terrace → raised terrace → covered outdoor area → additional interior room / support space. The glazed interior is accessed separately from the open terrace; there is no direct connection to the covered area.

Proposed sizes & layout notes

Henri’s: 5 × 4 m display footprint within the covered area. Guest brands: 2.5 × 2 m each. These are proposed allocations, not confirmed stand dimensions. The weather alternative requires the additional interior room. Access, circulation, level changes, food equipment and the Saturday evening changeover still need an on-site check. This diagram does not establish venue capacity.

05 / The people

A local gathering.
An international crowd.

Across the events we organise, we reach a community in Luxembourg with strong connections to the Spanish, Italian and wider international crowd.

We will use our Instagram channels and WhatsApp communities to introduce the pop-up and its participating brands. It is an opportunity to meet people face to face and connect with the audiences of the other brands.

06 / The practical side

Before we
make it official.

Which brands are taking part?

Henri’s is the lead brand. Guest selection is in progress, with a working layout for five additional brands. No guest-brand line-up is confirmed on this page.

How does Saturday evening work?

The retail area will be reorganised before the evening DJ session. Storage space is available at the venue; the exact storage allocation, handling arrangements and retail closing time will be confirmed with participants.

What happens if we cannot use the terrace?

The proposed alternative moves the outdoor brands into the additional interior room and reduces the lounge area. This arrangement is still subject to an on-site layout check and confirmation that the room is available.

Who handles sales, setup and equipment?

Sales and payment responsibilities, staffing requirements, furniture, electricity, setup and dismantling times are being defined. These details will be included in the final participation terms.

How do I express interest?

Reply to the Henri’s or Le Gilda Club team member who shared this invitation. Tell us about your brand, your products and the display space you need. The direct event contact and confirmation deadline will be added to the final version.
